fields.emailaddress.update.description: Tool to update the configuration of an email address field in Fireberry. Use when you need to modify field properties such as label, required status, autocomplete behavior, or validation rules.

fields.number.update.description: Tool to update a number field configuration in Fireberry. Use when you need to modify number field properties such as label, precision, default value, tracking settings, or additional properties (required/readonly).

additionalProperty.description: Additional properties that can be set on a number field.

fieldName.description: The system name of the field being updated. This is the unique identifier for the number field.

follow.description: To track all changes made to this field, enter 'true'. When enabled, all modifications to this field will be logged.

label.description: Field name used for system displays. This is the human-readable label shown in the UI.

precision.description: Number between 0-4 to set the amount of digits after the decimal point. Defaults to 0 if not specified.

label.description: Field name used for system displays. This is the human-readable label shown in the UI.

meetings.create.description: Tool to create a new meeting (activity) in Fireberry. Use when you need to schedule a meeting in the CRM system. The created meeting will be returned with its system-generated ID and all default values populated.

activitytypecode.description: The type of activity (Picklist). Numeric code identifying the activity type.

description.description: Description of the meeting, up to 4,000 characters.

location.description: Location where the meeting will take place.

objectid.description: The GUID of the record related to the meeting. If set, objecttypecode must also be provided.

ownerid.description: The GUID of the system user who created the record. Can be set manually. Will be used for permissions.

prioritycode.description: Priority of the meeting (Picklist). Numeric code indicating priority level.

resource.description: The GUID of the resource used for the meeting.

scheduledend.description: Date and time the meeting ends. Must be in valid date format.

scheduledstart.description: Date and time the meeting starts. Must be in valid date format.

statuscode.description: Status of the meeting (Picklist). Numeric code indicating meeting status.

subject.description: The subject of the meeting (Primary). This is a required field.

meetings.delete.description: Tool to delete a meeting activity from Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to remove an existing meeting record from the system.

id.description: Must be a globally unique identifier (GUID) in the format xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx of the meeting activity to delete.

meetings.delete.title: Delete a Meeting

id.description: The GUID (unique identifier) of the meeting/activity record to retrieve. Must be a valid GUID format.

meetings.get.title: Get a Meeting

pagenumber.description: The number of the page displayed, cannot exceed 10

pagesize.description: The maximum number of records displayed per page, cannot exceed 50

meetings.list.title: Get All Meetings

activitytypecode.description: The type of activity (Picklist integer code).

description.description: Description of the meeting, up to 4,000 characters.

id.description: The GUID of the meeting activity to update.

objectid.description: The GUID of the record related to the meeting. If set, you MUST also set objecttitle and objecttypecode.

objecttitle.description: Primary field of the related record. Required if objectid is set.

objecttypecode.description: Object number of the object the related record belongs to. Required if objectid is set.

ownerid.description: The GUID of the system user who owns the record. Used for permissions.

prioritycode.description: Priority of the meeting (Picklist integer code).

resource.description: The GUID of the resource used for the meeting.

scheduledend.description: Date and time the meeting ends (ISO 8601 format).

scheduledstart.description: Date and time the meeting starts (ISO 8601 format).

statuscode.description: Status of the meeting (Picklist integer code).

subject.description: The subject of the meeting (Primary field).

field_name.description: System field name of the field to retrieve details for (e.g., 'emailaddress1', 'accountname', 'statuscode'). This is the internal field identifier used by Fireberry.

metadata.picklist_values.title: Get Picklist Field Values

accountid.description: The related account's GUID. Links this opportunity to a specific account/company.

contacttid.description: The related contact's GUID. Links this opportunity to a specific contact person.

estimatedclosedate.description: Expected close date for the opportunity in UTC format (YYYY-MM-DD).

order_items.create.description: Tool to create a new order item in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add line items or products to an existing order with details like quantity, price, and description.

catalognumber.description: Set the catalog number of the product for inventory tracking and identification.

crmorderid.description: Use an Order's globally unique identifier (GUID) to set which order this item will appear in and be related to. This is required to associate the item with an existing order.

description.description: Free text description of the order item or product to provide additional details.

itemorder.description: Set the order the items will be listed in, will appear in ascending order starting with the lowest at the top. Use integer values to control display sequence.

itemprice.description: Set the price of the product as a decimal number. This is the unit price before quantity calculation.

itemquantity.description: Set the quantity of the product. Can be a decimal for fractional quantities (e.g., 2.5 units).

ownerid.description: A system user's GUID, will fill in automatically with the user who created the item and be used for permissions. Can be set manually to assign ownership.

productid.description: Use a product's globally unique identifier (GUID) to relate it to this order item from the product catalog.

productname.description: Set the name of a related or custom product. This is the required primary field for the order item.

targetext.description: The extension of the receiving phone number.

targetid.description: The phone number receiving the call. Format depends on your system configuration.

records.create.description: Creates a new record in a specified Fireberry table/module. Use this tool when you need to add new records to Fireberry (e.g., create a new account, contact, or deal). The created record will be returned with its system-generated ID and all default values populated. Common use cases: - Create new accounts/companies in the CRM - Add new contacts to the system - Insert leads, opportunities, or custom records Note: Field names are case-sensitive and must match Fireberry's system field names.

record.description: Dictionary of field names and values for the new record. Field names must match Fireberry's system field names (e.g., 'accountname', 'emailaddress1', 'telephone2'). Required fields depend on the table schema - typically the primary field (like 'accountname' for Account table) is required. Optional fields can be omitted.

table_name.description: Name or numeric ID of the Fireberry object/table where the record will be created. Common examples: 'Account' (for accounts), 'Contact' (for contacts), or numeric IDs like '1', '2'. The name is case-sensitive.

records.create.title: Create a new Fireberry record

records.query.description: Query and retrieve records from a Fireberry module with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use this tool to: - List all records from a module (Accounts, Contacts, etc.) - Search for specific records using filter conditions - Sort results by one or more fields - Paginate through large result sets The tool returns record data with Fireberry system field names (e.g., 'accountname', 'emailaddress1', 'createdon').

fields.description: Optional list of specific field names to return in the results. Note: The API may return all fields regardless of this parameter. Field names should match the Fireberry field system names (e.g., 'accountname', 'emailaddress1').

filter.description: Defines a single filter condition for querying records.

moduleId.description: The module identifier to query records from. Common values: '1' for Accounts, '2' for Contacts. Can be numeric string or module system name. Must be a numeric string; named strings like 'contacts' cause an invalid objecttype error.

pageSize.description: Number of records per page (must be >= 1)

sort.description: Optional list of sorting rules to order the results. Multiple sort fields will be applied in the order specified.

records.query.title: Fireberry: Query Records

records.query_legacy.description: Query records in any Fireberry object with advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use the query field to specify filter conditions that records must meet to be returned. This action provides direct access to Fireberry's query API endpoint with support for complex filter expressions, field selection, and result ordering. Ideal for searching specific records, building reports, or retrieving filtered datasets.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of field names to return in the results. If not specified, all fields are returned. Use Fireberry system field names (e.g., 'accountname,emailaddress1,telephone1').

object.description: The object type to query. Use the object's system name (e.g., 'account', 'contact', 'lead') or numeric ID. Common values: 'account' or '1' for Accounts, 'contact' or '2' for Contacts, 'cases' or '5' for Cases.

objecttype.description: The object type identifier as an integer (e.g., 1 for Account, 2 for Contact, 5 for Cases). If not provided, the system will attempt to resolve from the 'object' parameter.

page_number.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Default is 1.

page_size.description: Number of records to return per page. Default is 50.

query.description: Query filter string to narrow down results. Use format: (fieldname operator value) with AND/OR operators for multiple conditions. Operators: = (equals), > (greater than), < (less than), >= (greater or equal), <= (less or equal), contains, startsWith, endsWith. Example: '(idnumber = 12345678)' or '(accountname contains Sample) AND (statuscode = 1)'.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort results by. Use Fireberry system field names (e.g., 'accountname', 'createdon').

sort_type.description: Sort direction: 'asc' for ascending (A-Z, oldest first) or 'desc' for descending (Z-A, newest first).
